name: Sam Bram
noteEs: Sam Bram (Sam Bramley) hace videos de calidad sobre Cyberpunk 2077, Fallout y Elder Scrolls — formato listicle de easter eggs, secretos, rankings y curiosidades. Es uno de los creators más consistentes para descubrir contenido oculto que la mayoría de players se pierde: dialogue secreto, locations no marcadas, conexiones de lore con el universo Cyberpunk pen-and-paper. Tono editorial mesurado, sin clickbait, narration clara — ideal para players post-campaign que quieren descubrir capas adicionales del juego.
noteEn: Sam Bram (Sam Bramley) makes quality videos about Cyberpunk 2077, Fallout, and Elder Scrolls — listicle format covering easter eggs, secrets, rankings, and trivia. He's one of the most consistent creators for surfacing hidden content most players miss: secret dialogue, unmarked locations, lore connections to the Cyberpunk pen-and-paper universe. Measured editorial tone, no clickbait, clear narration — ideal for post-campaign players wanting to discover additional layers of the game.
highlightsEs: Series de 25/50/100 secretos y easter eggs en Cyberpunk 2077 — fuente de descubrimientos para playthroughs nuevos
